name: Adrienne Allan
headline: Senior Director, Partnership Strategy & Growth | Building High-Impact Collaborations Between Brands and Organizations
about:
I have 15+ years' experience building strategic partnerships and campaigns that connect brands, media, and nonprofits in ways that drive real results and meaningful impact. I specialize in brand partnerships, sponsorships, integrations, cause marketing, and multi-platform initiatives, with a track record of securing multi-year commitments and growing lasting relationships. I’m also passionate about leading teams and coaching talented people to deliver creative, high-performing campaigns that advance organizational goals. I thrive on turning strategy into action, building strong partnerships, and telling the stories that make those collaborations matter.

experiences.description:
Develop and manage a diverse portfolio of national corporate partners, while proactively prospecting and qualifying new leads to expand the partnership pipeline. Lead the development and execution of cause marketing campaigns, brand sponsorships, grant programs, and employee engagement initiatives that help drive $4M+ in annual revenue.

• Expand donor pipelines into untapped industries (Gas/Energy, CPG, Property Restoration, Toys) unlocking new financial and in-kind support that delivers measurable impact.
• Prospected and qualified high-value corporate leads nationwide to build a strong pipeline for strategic partnerships.
• Lead full-cycle partnership management, from prospecting and pitching to activation and stewardship, securing multi-year commitments and successful renewals.
• Collaborate with senior leadership, marketing, research, and national on-site teams to co-create innovative activations and optimize partner experiences across a federated network.
• Cultivate and grow long-term partner relationships, building trust and collaboration beyond business transactions.
• Plan and execute flagship fundraising events, including The Great Games Challenge (2024), engaging 150+ executives and generating $376K in incremental revenue (+12% YoY).
• Proven track record of growing revenue, deepening partnerships, and advancing mission-driven initiatives that help families stay close to the medical care they need.

Responsible for setting brand sponsorship strategy across CBC’s programming portfolio; driver of product innovation and partnership opportunities to support sales and programming relationships. Lead development of content marketing solutions, including: media strategies, creative concepts, distribution plans, data insights and research across all channels and platforms. Oversee execution of all marketing sponsorships from pre-sale through to post-campaign analysis. Act as the principal contact for senior level clients and agencies/vendors/production.

•	Lead a national team to build strategic ROI-positive brand campaigns and partnerships
•	Develop data-driven and consumer research-based commercial media programs, creative concepts and distribution plans
•	Generate non-traditional revenues in excess of $10MM+ annually across all platforms and channels (including broadcast, digital, digital audio, social, XM, OTT)
•	Drive annual marketing plans, including quarterly and annual forecasts, business reviews and analysis

Created CBC’s first national team entirely dedicated to streamlining the integrated marketing process. Led all sponsorship and non-traditional media requests including integrated marketing strategies and multi-platform campaigns for global brands across all consumer-centric categories. 

•	Developed two of CBC Entertainment’s most successful integrated campaigns to date:
o	The first ever multi-platform campaign with CBC Music ($1MM+)
o	The largest in-show brand integration across four of CBC’s top programs ($1MM+)

•	Represented CBC at European Group of Television Advertisers (EGTA) "Best Practices & Innovation" Bootcamp in Brussels, Belgium
